Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-August 2024

Body.Content:
In mid-August 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

You can now configure the maintenance window for the named replica in the Azure SQL Database Hyperscale service tier to minimize the impact on read workloads during critical times.

Learn more.
